notes:
PASS on the fake backend, final gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/go2-convex-mpc, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the R0 floor of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The model is the card's models[0], models/MJCF/go2/scene.xml, read in place from the pinned clone (robots/elijah-waichong-chan/go2-convex-mpc/models/MJCF/go2/scene.xml; never copied, imported, installed or modified). It includes models/MJCF/go2/go2.xml: 12 motor actuators (FR, FL, RR, RL; a hip, thigh and calf per leg), 19 qpos, 18 dof, and actuator ctrlranges of -23.7 to 23.7 for the eight hip/thigh motors and -45.43 to 45.43 for the four knee motors. The bridge derives action.ctrl's per-actuator bounds from the model, so the package writes no Limit of its own. The fake backend is fake.py, a callable stand-in mujoco module that parses the same scene and included model and integrates a placeholder first-order motion; the gate therefore warns G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (there is no package fake class surface for the family to record) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and the reset seed; these are the expected simulator-family warnings. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself was not installed and was never run, so no trajectory of this package is an engine result; the fake loads no mesh, texture, contact, friction, actuator or sensor dynamics; the model states no <option timestep> and the published 2.0 ms timestep is the fake's placeholder for the MuJoCo library default, while the upstream demos set model.opt.timestep to 1 ms (examples/ex00_demo.py:83-85,185-186); the bridge's ctrl order is the model actuator order FR, FL, RR, RL while the upstream set_joint_torque vector is FL, FR, RL, RR (src/convex_mpc/mujoco_model.py:41-46) and the upstream MPC, gait and leg controllers are not served; cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData and does not apply the home keyframe (models/MJCF/go2/go2.xml:285-288), and the fake starts its arrays at zero instead of the model's base height z=0.445 m; no rendering, cameras or sensor streams are served; only the primary scene is served, not scene_terrain.xml or the URDF; no physical Go2 is modelled or driven and no hardware run is claimed. Snapshot/restore is advertised through the bridge and declared in fidelity, but it is not covered by the CL3 gate; an in-process restore of the snapshot returned by mhs.snapshot was rejected with MHS.CONFLICT.STATE_HASH because the bridge's snapshot document differs from the read state whose hash the server stores. That is an SDK-layer observation, not a driver result, and it is not presented as engine or hardware validation. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null).
